description: For every arithmetic sentence \(\sigma\), the arithmetic ultrapower satisfies \(\sigma\) if and only if the ordinary natural-number arithmetic structure satisfies \(\sigma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.Arithmetic.sentence_transfer (U : Ultrafilter ℕ)
  (σ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.Arithmetic.Power U ⊨ σ ↔ ℕ ⊨ σ
